title: Hanasato Minori — Blessings From My Friends〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here's to a great practice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Kohane & Nene
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd like to thank you again, Kohane, for letting us join your team for practice today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Getting to practice like this with everyone was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
About that, Kohane.
Are your practices always like that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Like how...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You know, how everyone seems a little nervous or on edge...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Was it a little too tense for you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, nothing like that. It's just, everyone was taking everything so seriously.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys are all just able to say what's on your mind right then and there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I noticed that too... You guys don't really hold back or try to coddle each other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's almost like it's hard to get mad when you're told something that bluntly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I thought that's really important!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. Being able to say what needs to be said or being willing to hear what you may not want to is no small feat.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! By doing that, you'll immediately get to know and even trust each other!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not only that, you guys are so detail-oriented.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... Yeah, I kept getting warnings about not staying in rhythm or maintaining my pitch...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, that was on a level where regular people probably wouldn't have been able to tell if they heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, Aoyagi has such good ears.
Does he have a deep music background?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, he does.
He used to do classical piano and violin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean Shiraishi and Shinonome can play instruments too...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, not as far as I know...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But An's liked music since she was little because her dad used to be a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We even formed our group in order to surpass this legendary event that he helped organize.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shinonome actually got into street music because of that event too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But he doesn't have much of a music background, so he had to learn everything on his own and practice so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All of that on his own...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I heard that your team's full of incredible people, but I didn't know just how incredible until we practiced together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you were brave enough to jump in with them! It's just so incredible!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Every other word you said just now was “incredible”, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that sense, you're just as incredible, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. You're working alongside three idols who used to be really popular in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: One of them being the Haruka Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Well what?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Kiritani's the idol you've been looking up to since you were little, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So she's like your hero...?
It may take a while until you catch up to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's the thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's not just Haruka.
Airi and Shizuku have been teaching me so much, but I still have such a long ways to go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But every time I face a new hurdle, I tell myself to not give up and just keep going!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I know exactly how she feels.
I've been chasing after Shiho this whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They also keep telling me that MORE MORE JUMP! isn't MORE MORE JUMP! unless we're all together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So no matter what it takes, I want to catch up to them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Minori...
That's so great.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and we believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, we don't really have that dynamic in our troupe...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But Hanasato said that she's chasing after her hero, so maybe Ms. Kazamatsuri's that person in my case.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like you're trying to beat a game on the hardest difficulty possible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I've felt that too actually...
But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're all doing everything in our power to achieve our goals and make our dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. And catching up to everyone else won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The people I care about most told me that they believe in me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I'm going to keep trying my best, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Your enthusiasm's so infectious. I feel like I need to keep trying my best now too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe! Let's start by doing everything we can for the Fan Festival, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since we're all here, shall we have a quick debrief and discuss what happened during practice today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Let's do it!
